name: D20 TEST
description: 'D20 TEST', 'On a d20 Test you roll a d20 dice and most of a time add a number to the result which decreases or increases the result which is made against some Difficulty Threshold [DT] that has to be exceeded.', 'd20-test

name: DT
description: 'DT', 'The difficulty of any [D20 TEST] is measured by the Difficulty Threshld ([DT]). The [DT] should be exlusivly based upon the difficulty of the action the actor attempts.', 'dt

name: ADVANTAGE
description: 'ADVANTAGE', 'When you make a [D20 TEST] you roll the d20 twice and take the better result.', 'adv-disadv

name: DISADVANTAGE
description: 'DISADVANTAGE', 'When you make a [D20 TEST] you roll the d20 twice and take the worse result.', 'adv-disadv

name: ATTRIBUTE TEST
description: 'ATTRIBUTE TEST', 'An [ATTRIBUTE TEST] is a [D20 TEST] to determine if you can succeed in a certain activity related to a specific Attribute. Simply roll a d20 and add the related Attribute.', 'attribute-test

name: SKILL TEST
description: 'SKILL TEST', 'A Skill Test is an [ATTRIBUTE TEST] where also ranks of a Skill can be added to the bonus.', '

name: MARTIAL TEST
description: 'MARTIAL TEST', 'Tests made when performing Martial Maneuvers. A [MARTIAL TEST] is a [D20 TEST] that benefits from your [MARTIAL LEVEL] and an Attribute that is stated in the context', '

description: 'MEELE MARTIAL ATTACK', combatDetailsJson.additionalCombatRules.attack.attackTypes[2].description, 'attack

description: 'RANGED MARTIAL ATTACK', combatDetailsJson.additionalCombatRules.attack.attackTypes[3].description, 'attack

name: SPELL CAST TEST
description: 'SPELL CAST TEST', 'Roll 2d6 + [SPELL LEVEL] and if the roll is lower than the Cast Difficulty of the Spell or double 1s, a magical mishap occurs after the spell was cast.', 'spell-test

name: SPELL TEST
description: 'SPELL TEST', 'Tests made when casting Spells. A [SPELL TEST] is a [D20 TEST] that benefits from your [SPELL LEVEL] and an Attribute that is stated in the context.', 'spell-test

name: MELEE SPELL ATTACK
description: 'MELEE SPELL ATTACK', combatDetailsJson.additionalCombatRules.attack.attackTypes[4].description, 'melee-spell-attack

name: RANGED SPELL ATTACK
description: 'RANGED SPELL ATTACK', combatDetailsJson.additionalCombatRules.attack.attackTypes[5].description, 'ranged-spell-attack

name: CONCENTRATION
description: 'CONCENTRATION', 'Abilities with these keywords need to activly maintained by the caster. They are listed with a number which denotes how much [AP] they need to spend to maintain the ability, if they are not able to spend the [AP] the ability ends.', 'concentration-test

name: CONCENTRATION TEST
description: 'CONCENTRATION TEST', '[SPELL TEST]. A Concentration Test determines if you can maintain focus on a spell while external factors attempt to disrupt it. A [CONCENTRATION TEST] is made by rolling a d20 and adding your Concentration Bonus, which is calculated the following way: [CON] + [SPELL LEVEL]', 'concentration-test

name: SHIELD BLOCK
description: 'SHIELD BLOCK', 'When wielding and hit by an [ATTACK], instead of a [DODGE] [SAVE] make a [SHIELD BLOCK]. Which is a [SAVE] with a bonus of Shield Block + [MARTIAL LEVEL]', 'shield-block

name: EXHAUSTION
description: 'EXHAUSTION', 'When characters push themselves beyond their physical limits, they suffer points of [EXHAUSTION] which grant a cumulative -1 penalty to any [D20 TEST]. If that increases beyond their limit they fall unconcious, if it increases above twice their limit they die.', 'exhaustion

name: DEATHS DOOR
description: 'DEATHS DOOR', '[DEATHS DOOR] is a mechanic that allows you to keep on fighting even when you are reduced to 0 [HP] however at great risks to yourself.', 'deaths-door

name: ROUND
description: 'ROUND', 'TODO', 'round

name: TURN
description: 'TURN', 'TODO', 'turn

name: MELEE RANGE
description: 'MELEE RANGE', 'within 1.5m of you, can be modified by [SIZE] and certain abilities', 'ranges

name: WEAPON RANGE
description: 'WEAPON RANGE', 'within range to be targeted by any weapon you wield, ranged or melee.', 'ranges

name: SELF
description: 'SELF', 'you are the target', 'targets

name: AURA
description: 'AURA', 'listed with a radius, effects every creature that is within range of that radius. The effect is applied at the start of the target creatures turn or the first time they enter the aura radius but only once during a [ROUND].', 'targets

name: SPHERE
description: 'SPHERE', 'listed with a radius, the center of a sphere needs to be within range of the ability and the center is always in between squares', 'targets

name: LINE
description: 'LINE', 'listed with a length x width. It starts from the caster of the ability and extends until the lenght.', 'targets

name: CONE
description: 'CONE', 'A cone with the listed length starting from the ability caster.', 'targets

name: AREA EFFECT
description: 'AREA EFFECT', 'Describes an ongoing effect in a designated target area that happens to a creature when it starts their [TURN] in the area or moves into the area for the first time in their [TURN].', 'targets

name: INSTANT
description: 'INSTANT', 'Ability happens now and there are no lingering effects. The actor can not use any other abilities until all the effects of this ability have been resolved.', 'duration

name: SAVE ENDS
description: 'SAVE ENDS', 'The target can repeat the [SAVE] at the end of each of their [TURN] ending all effects of the ability on a sucess', 'targets

name: LEVEL
description: 'LEVEL', 'Your characters current [LEVEL], it increases as your character spends time adventuring and earns [XP]. When your [LEVEL] increases your characters statistics also improve in several ways.', 'level'

name: MARTIAL LEVEL
description: 'MARTIAL LEVEL', 'Your Characters [MARTIAL LEVEL] is calculated by multiplying the Martial Level Progression of your Class with your [LEVEL] and rounding down.', 'martial-level'

name: SPELL LEVEL
description: 'SPELL LEVEL', 'Your Characters [SPELL LEVEL] is calculated by multiplying the Spellcasting Level Progression of your Class with your [LEVEL] and rounding down.', 'spell-level'

name: HP
description: 'HP', 'Health Points. Represents how much damage you can take before going unconcious.', 'hp'

name: THP
description: 'THP', 'Temporary health points. They are a buffer against damage, a pool of hit points that protect you from injury.', 'thp'

name: MARTIAL DAMAGE
description: 'MARTIAL DAMAGE', 'The damage you deal with weapon attacks, split into light, one-handed and two-handed damage.', 'martial-damage'

name: STAMINA
description: 'STAMINA', '[STAMINA] is your energy reserve with which you can replenish your Resources like HP and Aether and is used up when performing physically demanding tasks.', 'stamina'

name: ARCANA
description: 'ARCANA', 'Your [ARCANA] represents an energy reserve you expend when drawing power from the elemental planes and the aether to cast spells.', 'arcana'

name: STABILITY TEST
description: 'STABILITY', 'A representation of the characters resistance against being forcefully moved or crushed against their will. Increases with your [STR]', 'stability'

name: DODGE TEST
description: 'DODGE', 'A representation of how good the character is at evading danger. Increases with your [AGI]', 'dodge'

name: TOUGHNESS TEST
description: 'TOUGHNESS', 'A representation of the characters bodily health and ability to resist internal injuries, poisons and concussions. Increases with your [CON]', 'toughness'

name: WILLPOWER TEST
description: 'WILLPOWER', ' A representation of how well the character can resist being mind-controlled, feeling fear or resisting other mind affecting effects. Increases with your [SPI]', 'willpower'

name: DR
description: 'DR', 'Damage Resistance provides flat damage reduction against incoming damage', 'dr'

name: FREE
description: 'FREE', 'Abilities with this Cost can be used any time and can also be used outside the actors [TURN] without consuming a [REACTION].', 'free'

name: AP
description: 'AP', 'Action Points. Actions in combat that are not exclusively movement related such as attacking, casting spells or activating magic items require [AP] when used. The more [AP] a character has available, the more they can do during their turn.', 'ap'

name: MP
description: 'MP', 'Movement points. It is a measurement to determine how much someone can move during Combat, one Movement Point is equal to 1.5m (1 Square).', 'mp'

name: REACTION
description: 'REACTION', 'Once during a combat round you can use a [REACTION] which you gain at the start of the battle unless stated otherwise. At the start of each of your turns you regain your [REACTION] but you can only have one.', ''

name: SIZE
description: 'SIZE', 'Most humanoids are medium [SIZE], however certain species have different ones and certain effects might change your [SIZE]. Changing your [SIZE] affects your [STR] and [DODGE].', 'size'

name: XP
description: 'XP', 'Experience Points. Experience is accumulated during play by adventuring, defeating Monsters, solving Quests, good role-play and other achievements the Game Master deems worth-wile.', 'xp'

name: SMALL COVER
description: 'SMALL COVER', 'If 25% of creatures visibility is blocked, when being targeted by an [ATTACK] unmodified roll of 1-5 always misses and +2 bonus to [DODGE] and [SHIELD BLOCK]', 'cover'

name: MEDIUM COVER
description: 'MEDIUM COVER', 'If 50% of creatures visibility is blocked, when being targeted by an [ATTACK] unmodified roll of 1-10 always misses and +4 bonus to [DODGE] and [SHIELD BLOCK]', 'cover'

name: LARGE COVER
description: 'LARGE COVER', 'If 75% of creatures visibility is blocked, when being targeted by an [ATTACK] unmodified roll of 1-15 always misses and +6 bonus to [DODGE] and [SHIELD BLOCK]', 'cover'

name: PRONE
description: 'PRONE', 'Lying on the Ground, Move Cost doubled, [DISADVANTAGE] when making a [MELEE ATTACK], [ADVANTAGE] when targeted by a [MELEE ATTACK], always recieving at least [SMALL COVER] against any [RANGED ATTACK]', 'prone'

name: FLANKING
description: 'FLANKING', 'When surrounding a target, recieve a +2 bonus to any [MELEE ATTACK] against Target.', 'flanking'

name: PARTIAL CONCEALMENT
description: 'PARTIAL CONCEALMENT', 'Concealment [DT] = 8 + Stealth Ranks, +5 bonus when making [ATTACK] against unaware target', 'concealment'

name: FULL CONCEALMENT
description: 'FULL CONCEALMENT', 'Concealment [DT] = 15 + Stealth Ranks, +5 bonus or [ADVANTAGE] when making [ATTACK] against unaware target', 'concealment'
